change_log.value: Add edge case handling for enrollment status

stories.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Normalization Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status including allowed values (RECRUITING, ACTIVE, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN) and mapping rules from raw ClinicalTrials.gov statuses to internal representation.

stories.title: Implement Enrollment Status Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and map raw values (e.g., RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED) into the normalized schema defined in the contract.

stories.title: Integrate Enrollment Status into Clinical Trials Service Output
stories.description: Extend the clinical trials service response model to include normalized enrollment status for each trial and ensure it is propagated through the evaluate care facade for downstream consumption.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Enrollment Status Mapping
stories.description: Create unit tests for enrollment status normalization logic and integration tests to verify correct propagation from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses through the service and facade layers.

stories.title: Handle Missing and Non-Standard Enrollment Status Values
stories.description: Implement fallback handling for missing, null, or unexpected enrollment status values from ClinicalTrials.gov, defaulting to UNKNOWN and ensuring no pipeline failures.
